decisions: Keep deterministic headless code separate from all presentation roots.
Flatten small presentation wrappers by responsibility; do not rename classes or authored IDs.
Keep every art instance, duplicate, prototype, font, generator and measurement artifact.
Keep binary font resources and model companions byte-identical; rewrite only enumerated text paths.
Preserve the frozen square-battle package and its historical archive paths byte-identically.
Keep the existing Fonts directory casing to avoid an unsafe Windows case-only rename.
Keep docs/plans frozen; translate their historical paths through this manifest.
Keep assets/models/dae/ intact as a legacy Collada bundle because relative dependencies and golf.material cannot be safely flattened or reserialized.

Deduplicating identical art whose ownership and future editing may differ.
Keeping src and scripts as wrapper roots.
Reserializing binary Godot font resources merely to reduce depth.
Rewriting frozen plans or the frozen square-battle archive.

`data/` is loaded only through `content/`. Nothing else reads the JSON
directly.

**The one asymmetry:** `AStarPathfinder`, `BFSFloodFill`, `LineOfSight`,
`ParabolicArc`, and `ShapeCaster` depend on nothing but `simulation/`.
`ThreatMap` is different — it takes `BattleState` and the movement/combat
resolvers, because an influence map is only accurate if it is built from the
same rules the simulation applies. It is consumed solely by `ai/`;
`simulation/` never imports it, so there is no cycle. Treat it as AI
support that happens to live in `algorithms/`, and do not copy its dependency
breadth into the other five.

Physical flattening does not merge logical layers: `simulation/`, `ai/`, and `content/` remain headless; `battle/`, `ui/`, `effects/`, `worldmap/`, and `map_editor/` remain presentation or authoring. `data/` is loaded only through `content/` factories.

## Dependency direction

```text
data/  ──►  content/  ──►  content/
                                      │
              simulation/, simulation/
                                      │
                                      ▼
                            simulation/  ◄── ai/
                                      │
                            BattleEvents / IBattleVisualAdapter
                                      │  (one way: events out, commands in)
                                      ▼
                            src/presentation/
                                      ▲
                                      │
                             src/systems/  ──►  scenes/HexBattle.tscn
```

Authored data and setup feed the headless simulation; `battle/`
orchestrates the Godot lifecycle; presentation observes through events and
adapters and submits commands back. **No arrow points from simulation into
presentation.** Reading a `BattleState` constant or static helper (for example
`BattleState.TERRAIN_ABYSS` or `BattleState.isPermanentDuration`) from
presentation is a read, not a dependency inversion, and is allowed.

## Where to make a change

| Change | Go to |
|---|---|
| Catalog content — a new monster, spell, passive, element | `data/*.json`, then the matching `content/*References.gd` if the schema changes |
| Combat rules, damage, status application | `simulation/CombatResolver.gd`, `DirectDamageRules.gd`, `SpellEffectResolver.gd`, `PassiveSkillResolver.gd` |
| Movement, reachability, line of sight | `simulation/MovementResolver.gd`, `simulation/` |
| Side order and round structure | `simulation/TurnManager.gd` |
| CPU behavior | `ai/` — pick the brain, `LegalActionEnumerator` for what is legal, `CandidateFilter` for what gets searched, or `CommandDeliberation` for the shipped search itself |
| Replay and serialization | `simulation/BattleStateSerializer.gd`, `BattleReplayRunner.gd` |
| Battle setup, modes, seeds, team construction | `simulation/BattleSetupConfig.gd`, `BattleSetupFactory.gd`, `content/BattleSetupPresets.gd` |
| Battle HUD, menus, windows, fonts | `src/presentation/BattleUIBuilder.gd`, `PlayerCommandMenu.gd`, `ui/` |
| Setup screen | `src/presentation/BattleSetupUI.gd` |
| Monster/board meshes and materials | `battle/BattleMeshFactory.gd` |
| Visual effects, animation pacing | `battle/BattleVisualEffects.gd`, `VisualActionQueue.gd`, `effects/` — see [`VFX_DESIGN.md`](./VFX_DESIGN.md) |
| Camera | `battle/BattleCameraController.gd` |
| Selected-unit phases, cursor ownership, undo | `battle/HexBattleMemberTurn.gd` |
| Scene lifecycle, side-turn pacing, adapter wiring | `battle/HexBattleController.gd` |
| Headless tooling and demos | `tools/` and `checks/` |
